content.summary: This investigation conducted during the 29th Indian Antarctic Expedition examines key glaciology phenomena in polar terrain around Schirmacher Oasis and Dronning Maud Land. The study records baseline scientific parameters and contributes to long-term monitoring of environmental changes in Antarctica.
